run
-d
-t
-m
2G
--name
test-agent
--workdir
/workspace
-e
SCION_AGENT_NAME=test-agent
-e
SCION_HOST_UID=HOST_ID
-e
SCION_HOST_GID=HOST_ID
-v
/host/src:/workspace
-e
SCION_METADATA_INTERCEPTION=off
scion-agent:latest
sh
-c
tmux new-session -d -s scion -n agent sh -c ''\''hello'\''; echo $? > /tmp/scion-harness-exit-code' \; set-option -g window-size latest \; new-window -t scion -n shell \; select-window -t scion:agent \; attach-session -t scion
